description: This file contains legacy database access functions for retrieving and inserting 'block' data using an old data model, primarily for data migration purposes within the focalboard project.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer, with methods for legacy block data handling.

methods.name: legacyBlocksFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of Block models, used for data migration.

methods.name: getLegacyBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a legacy block by ID and workspace ID from the database.

methods.name: insertLegacyBlock
methods.description: Inserts or updates a legacy block into the database, including history logging.
